purpose: Teach: じゅん/素子/すぅ/稔/ヤマト/松子/春日/立花

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスのじゅんと仲良いな
lines.en: Riku, you're pretty close with Jun from the class next door, aren't you.
lines.style: Light, probing observation. Half-smile. Casual lean. Testing whether he'll admit it or deflect. No real accusation — just curiosity with a small edge.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお姉さん、素子さんって名前だったよな、桜
lines.en: Your older sister's name is Motoko, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Deflection disguised as innocent question. Quick redirect — changing the subject before she pushes further. Calm surface but slight tension underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、寝る時に「すぅ」って言ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you make that little "suu" sound when you sleep.
lines.style: Dry, matter-of-fact delivery. The kind of observation that lands because it's true and useless. Small smile — not cruel, just watching him register that she's noticed things.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、隣の稔おじさんと挨拶してたな、桜
lines.en: You were saying hello to Mr. Minoru from next door the other day, Sakura.
lines.style: Same deflection rhythm as before. Tosses it back at her like a casual volley. Keeping the game equal — I know things about you too. Light, measured.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ヤマト運輸のバイト気になってたな
lines.en: Riku, you were curious about that Yamato Logistics delivery job.
lines.style: Another small observation. Softer this time — not teasing. Genuine interest underneath. Watching for a reaction. The kind of thing you mention when you're actually paying attention.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、隣のクラスの松子と話してたな、桜
lines.en: You were talking to Matsuko from the next class, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: The same rhythm again — but his voice is steadier now. Less deflection, more like he's relaxing into the game. Still guarded but engaging. Eyes meeting hers.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族で春日大社行ったろ
lines.en: Riku, didn't your family go to Kasuga Taisha together?
lines.style: Shift toward something softer. This one feels less like teasing, more like genuine curiosity about something that matters. Slower pace. Watching his face for the answer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、立花先生のお花の授業楽しんでたな、桜
lines.en: You really seemed to be enjoying Ms. Tachibana's flower arrangement class, Sakura.
lines.style: Quieter, warmer. Almost gentle. He's moved past deflection — this is real interest now. Close, attentive, the kind of attention that makes someone feel seen. Soft eye contact.
